# SCI-POINT Stage A `r0.2` To `r0.3` Semantic-Change Report

Identity: `SCI-POINT_STAGE_A_SEMANTIC_CHANGE v0.1/r0.3`

## Preserved

The repair preserves the known-source observation-local per-array operation;
no POINT aggregate or correction; downstream pointing-support and AST
ownership; four distinct parent families; terminal-FRUIT ancestry; coadd and
intermediate exclusion; symbolic zero-background six-role Gaussian family;
unavailable numerical compatibility and formal-error methods; exact source/
map/search/centroid separation; AltAz displacement sign; per-array atomicity;
source association; route response; residual honesty; bounded fitted-value/QC
claims; adjacent ownership; implementation blindness; and every nonclaim.

## Repaired Or Added

- `diagnostic_only` was removed from SCI-VAL eligibility and producer state;
  diagnostic limitation is represented by consumer action
  `diagnostic_display_only` after request, applicability, eligibility, and
  realization are evaluated;
- an exact product/claim dependency matrix prevents response or covariance
  unavailability from either universally erasing or universally authorizing
  products;
- `POINT-FULL-MAP-RMS-METHOD v0.1` was added as a third distinct unavailable
  authority that blocks only the dynamic-range diagnostic;
- source association now applies independently to every search, fallback,
  restart, and retry branch;
- known, isolated, bright, and approximately centered are typed applicability
  facts rather than informal adjectives;
- each parent file is explicitly a draft boundary requirement, and exact
  signal roles distinguish MAP/JINC/FLT signal parents from companion state;
- source association, fixed-branch response, full-procedure response, and
  observational bias/accuracy are separately addressable product roles;
- amplitude is a candidate input—not pre-eligible—for CAL/TolProj admission;
  and `fitted_amplitude_over_full_map_rms` is the canonical descriptive ratio;
- method-family wording no longer implies adoption of unavailable width,
  objective, weight, search, solution, association, RMS, or formal-error
  details; and
- six asymmetric method/dependency predictions were added.

## Current Availability

The following remain `unavailable_pending_separate_owner_approval`:

- `POINT-COMPATIBILITY-METHOD v0.1`;
- `POINT-FORMAL-ERROR-METHOD v0.1`; and
- `POINT-FULL-MAP-RMS-METHOD v0.1`.

Exact numerical parent-route instances, registered named-use profiles,
fixed/full procedure response, and observational bias/accuracy also remain
unavailable. The dependency matrix defines the distinct consequences; no
implementation behavior closes a gate.

No numerical route, implementation conformity, response/covariance fidelity,
uncertainty coverage, pointing accuracy, observational validation, performance,
readiness, production suitability, production authorization, or Unity activity
is claimed. Stage B has not been launched.
